# Thareia's sound studio, vendored

Copied unchanged from the New-game repo, branch `claude/tender-babbage-4wiplk`, folder `thareia/sfx/`:
`sounds.js` (the effects library), `music.js` (pieces played live from the same voices), and the sound-board page
and its build tool, for auditioning. See `README.md`. The game plays these through `src/audio/sound.js`.
